Inmate Pryor ADC#900318 in 2 Barracks refusing orders to lock down
~9:40pm
Sgt Coleman gave 3 direct orders to cuff up — Pryor ignored all
Pryor punched Sgt Coleman in face — split lip, bleeding

Pryor said "fuck you, I ain't going nowhere, you can't make me"
Sgt Coleman seen by Infirmary — cleaned wound, no sutures needed
Company Nurse called (877) 555-0100 — confirmation #CN-20260721-8823
Officer Accident Report completed by Sgt Coleman
